artifacts.summary: Six-phase, 4.25-hour plan amending report-format.md (full carried-figure contract) and plan-format.md (pointing extension), with a measured decision gate on the narrow impossible-assertion detector and a pre-written reasoned-exclusion contingency.

memory_candidates.content: When a plan's own text must carry figures it did not measure (e.g. numbers inherited from a research report), state them with the artifact's own marking convention and add a first phase that discharges each mark by re-derivation. This makes the plan an instance of the contract it is landing, and turns 'did the implementer verify the inherited numbers' from an implicit hope into a phase with verification criteria.
